user_saw: A guest who could read a conversation was missing from its mention picker and could not receive or manage mentions in their Inbox.
summary: The fix lets guests with session read access receive targeted Inbox updates and list or dismiss their own mentions for conversations they can still access.
reasoning: I checked the original Inbox diff, which explicitly required broad operator read access before session-only grants existed. PR #155184 expanded scoped conversation access and switched the documented guest role from broad grants to session-only grants while retaining the Inbox gates. PR #178038 later enabled guest sending and lookup while explicitly retaining the broad-read requirement for Inbox RPCs.
